description: n-gram (prompt lookup) speculative decoding vs plain decoding, SmolLM2-135M on MPS fp16, greedy (outputs are the same text in both configs, so per-token latency is directly comparable). Speculation is used only while <= 4 sequences decode, so the 16-client scenario checks that it switches off without a regression. Prefix caching off to isolate the effect.
